_notes: One-of-a-kind items carried by hidden sellers. Written by tools/build_secrets.py; a seller lists one as "unique:<id>" (world/vendor_stock.make_unique).

rh_sandpit_longbow.name: Sandpit Longbow
rh_sandpit_longbow.flavor_text: Strung with something that isn't sinew, and better for it.

rh_gravel_tongue.name: Gravel-Tongue
rh_gravel_tongue.flavor_text: It mutters when it's warm. It's always warm.

rh_thornjaw_maul.name: Thornjaw Maul
rh_thornjaw_maul.flavor_text: Somebody hammered raptor teeth into the head and never said why.

rh_ironbark_quarterstaff.name: Ironbark Quarterstaff
rh_ironbark_quarterstaff.flavor_text: Cut from a tree that grew on the wrong side of the Barrens.

rh_barracks_door.name: The Barracks Door
rh_barracks_door.flavor_text: Taken off its hinges one night. Nobody has noticed the draught.

brill_grisle_grisles_stitched_mantle.name: Grisle's Stitched Mantle
brill_grisle_grisles_stitched_mantle.flavor_text: Stitched from three other mantles. You can see the seams if you look.

brill_grisle_bonepicker_gloves.name: Bonepicker Gloves
brill_grisle_bonepicker_gloves.flavor_text: The fingertips are worn through from careful work.

uc_edwin_sewer_lantern_staff.name: Sewer-Lantern Staff
uc_edwin_sewer_lantern_staff.flavor_text: The lantern still lights. Nobody has ever filled it.

uc_edwin_rat_kings_buckler.name: Rat King's Buckler
uc_edwin_rat_kings_buckler.flavor_text: Gnawed round the rim, and none the weaker for it.

uc_edwin_drainwalker_boots.name: Drainwalker Boots
uc_edwin_drainwalker_boots.flavor_text: They never quite dry out. They never quite need to.

org_gashna_gashnas_spare_axe.name: Gashna's Spare Axe
org_gashna_gashnas_spare_axe.flavor_text: She calls it her spare. Nobody has seen the first one.

org_gashna_cleft_shadow_hood.name: Cleft-Shadow Hood
org_gashna_cleft_shadow_hood.flavor_text: Smells of incense and bad decisions.

org_gashna_hammer_of_old_debts.name: Hammer of Old Debts
org_gashna_hammer_of_old_debts.flavor_text: Every dent is somebody who paid late.

xroads_tazzle_tariff_dodgers_boomstick.name: Tariff-Dodger's Boomstick
xroads_tazzle_tariff_dodgers_boomstick.flavor_text: Fires straight, mostly. Sounds expensive every time.

xroads_tazzle_bribe_lined_vest.name: Bribe-Lined Vest
xroads_tazzle_bribe_lined_vest.flavor_text: There are coins sewn into the lining. Don't spend them.

xroads_tazzle_caravan_ledger.name: Caravan Ledger
xroads_tazzle_caravan_ledger.flavor_text: Every column adds up to somebody else's loss.

taurajo_brannoch_plainsrunner_longbow.name: Plainsrunner Longbow
taurajo_brannoch_plainsrunner_longbow.flavor_text: Carved by hand, by somebody who has missed before and didn't like it.

taurajo_brannoch_kodo_hide_bracers.name: Kodo-Hide Bracers
taurajo_brannoch_kodo_hide_bracers.flavor_text: Stiff for a month, then never again.

taurajo_brannoch_brannochs_walking_stick.name: Brannoch's Walking Stick
taurajo_brannoch_brannochs_walking_stick.flavor_text: He says he doesn't need it any more. He's lying.

ratchet_lissa_wreck_divers_goggles.name: Wreck-Diver's Goggles
ratchet_lissa_wreck_divers_goggles.flavor_text: The left lens has a crack shaped like a shark.

ratchet_lissa_barnacled_cutlass.name: Barnacled Cutlass
ratchet_lissa_barnacled_cutlass.flavor_text: Six weeks on the seabed and it still holds an edge.

ratchet_lissa_brine_soaked_sash.name: Brine-Soaked Sash
ratchet_lissa_brine_soaked_sash.flavor_text: Salt has worked into every thread. It hums at high tide.

splinter_grokka_felled_ancients_branch.name: Felled Ancient's Branch
splinter_grokka_felled_ancients_branch.flavor_text: Cut from a tree that was older than the Horde. It hasn't forgiven anyone.

splinter_grokka_splintered_warboard.name: Splintered Warboard
splinter_grokka_splintered_warboard.flavor_text: Made of the same planks as the palisade.

astranaar_sevalis_glaive_of_the_quiet_gr.name: Glaive of the Quiet Grove
astranaar_sevalis_glaive_of_the_quiet_gr.flavor_text: Older than Astranaar. Possibly older than the trees.

astranaar_sevalis_owlfeather_cloak.name: Owlfeather Cloak
astranaar_sevalis_owlfeather_cloak.flavor_text: Every feather was given, not taken. She's sure of it.

sepulcher_ashmund_ashmunds_burial_wraps.name: Ashmund's Burial Wraps
sepulcher_ashmund_ashmunds_burial_wraps.flavor_text: Somebody was buried in these. They won't be needing them.

sepulcher_ashmund_gravewardens_spade.name: Gravewarden's Spade
sepulcher_ashmund_gravewardens_spade.flavor_text: It digs. It also does the other thing.

sepulcher_ashmund_coffin_nail_ring.name: Coffin-Nail Ring
sepulcher_ashmund_coffin_nail_ring.flavor_text: Bent into a loop by somebody with very strong hands.

tarrenmill_calloway_calloways_mourning_v.name: Calloway's Mourning Veil
tarrenmill_calloway_calloways_mourning_v.flavor_text: Black lace, very fine, very old.

tarrenmill_calloway_millstone_crusher.name: Millstone Crusher
tarrenmill_calloway_millstone_crusher.flavor_text: Part of the old mill. The rest of it is still in the river.

hammerfall_mog_stromgarde_trophy_blade.name: Stromgarde Trophy Blade
hammerfall_mog_stromgarde_trophy_blade.flavor_text: Pulled from a wall in Stromgarde. The wall didn't want to let go.

hammerfall_mog_ogre_tooth_pauldrons.name: Ogre-Tooth Pauldrons
hammerfall_mog_ogre_tooth_pauldrons.flavor_text: The teeth are real. The ogre was not consulted.

hammerfall_mog_highland_stalkers_bow.name: Highland Stalker's Bow
hammerfall_mog_highland_stalkers_bow.flavor_text: Strung tight enough to hum in the wind.

bootybay_vell_smugglers_hand_cannon.name: Smuggler's Hand Cannon
bootybay_vell_smugglers_hand_cannon.flavor_text: Small enough to hide, loud enough to regret.

bootybay_vell_revilgazs_missing_ring.name: Revilgaz's Missing Ring
bootybay_vell_revilgazs_missing_ring.flavor_text: The Baron says he never lost a ring. Vell says otherwise.

gromgol_zuni_hushfangs_fetish_staff.name: Hushfang's Fetish Staff
gromgol_zuni_hushfangs_fetish_staff.flavor_text: The shrunken thing on top nods along when you talk.

gromgol_zuni_ziggurat_ward.name: Ziggurat Ward
gromgol_zuni_ziggurat_ward.flavor_text: Carved stone, carried by somebody very strong once.

freewind_talo_windcaught_mantle.name: Windcaught Mantle
freewind_talo_windcaught_mantle.flavor_text: Found on a spire nobody can climb. Talo won't say how.

freewind_talo_needlepoint_spear.name: Needlepoint Spear
freewind_talo_needlepoint_spear.flavor_text: Long enough to reach across a rope bridge, and he has.

freewind_talo_skyhide_wristwraps.name: Skyhide Wristwraps
freewind_talo_skyhide_wristwraps.flavor_text: Soft as a cloud and about as warm.

stw_fizzby_dune_sealed_robes.name: Dune-Sealed Robes
stw_fizzby_dune_sealed_robes.flavor_text: Not one grain of sand gets in. Fizzby guarantees it.

echo_zenji_zenjis_bone_charm_staff.name: Zenji's Bone Charm Staff
echo_zenji_zenjis_bone_charm_staff.flavor_text: Every bone on it belonged to somebody who owed her.

onyx_dagna_fell_off_the_forge_warhammer.name: Fell-Off-the-Forge Warhammer
onyx_dagna_fell_off_the_forge_warhammer.flavor_text: It fell off the forge. Onto a cart. Which drove here.

onyx_dagna_coalbeards_heirloom_plate.name: Coalbeard's Heirloom Plate
onyx_dagna_coalbeards_heirloom_plate.flavor_text: Three generations of Coalbeards wore it. Two survived.

kael_lirael_unindexed_spellblade.name: Unindexed Spellblade
kael_lirael_unindexed_spellblade.flavor_text: There's no entry for it in any catalogue. She checked.

kael_lirael_sunstrand_pendant.name: Sunstrand Pendant
kael_lirael_sunstrand_pendant.flavor_text: Warm when somebody lies to you.

durotar_grallik_scorpid_tail_flail.name: Scorpid-Tail Flail
durotar_grallik_scorpid_tail_flail.flavor_text: The barb still twitches in the heat.

durotar_grallik_hermits_lantern_staff.name: Hermit's Lantern Staff
durotar_grallik_hermits_lantern_staff.flavor_text: He reads by it. He doesn't read much.

nbarrens_mirela_thunderhoof_maul.name: Thunderhoof Maul
nbarrens_mirela_thunderhoof_maul.flavor_text: Heavy enough to stop a kodo. It has.

nbarrens_mirela_sandsong_shawl.name: Sandsong Shawl
nbarrens_mirela_sandsong_shawl.flavor_text: Woven from kodo hair and patience.

nbarrens_mirela_plainswalker_boots.name: Plainswalker Boots
nbarrens_mirela_plainswalker_boots.flavor_text: Resoled six times and still going.

sbarrens_snitch_vault_cracker_hammer.name: Vault-Cracker Hammer
sbarrens_snitch_vault_cracker_hammer.flavor_text: Built for doors. Works on most things that aren't doors too.

sbarrens_snitch_baeldun_blunderbuss.name: Bael'dun Blunderbuss
sbarrens_snitch_baeldun_blunderbuss.flavor_text: Dwarven make. Goblin improvements. Mostly improvements.

sbarrens_snitch_borrowed_ironforge_belt.name: Borrowed Ironforge Belt
sbarrens_snitch_borrowed_ironforge_belt.flavor_text: Snitch says borrowed. Nobody's asked for it back.

ashen_kyrenne_felscorched_robe.name: Felscorched Robe
ashen_kyrenne_felscorched_robe.flavor_text: The hem is singed green and won't wash out.

ashen_kyrenne_shadowbark_recurve.name: Shadowbark Recurve
ashen_kyrenne_shadowbark_recurve.flavor_text: Carved from a tree that died standing.

ashen_kyrenne_satyrbane_glaive.name: Satyrbane Glaive
ashen_kyrenne_satyrbane_glaive.flavor_text: Made for satyrs. It isn't fussy.

needles_skyfeather_mesa_runners_jerkin.name: Mesa Runner's Jerkin
needles_skyfeather_mesa_runners_jerkin.flavor_text: Cut for climbing. Stitched for falling.

needles_skyfeather_skyfeather_totem.name: Skyfeather Totem
needles_skyfeather_skyfeather_totem.flavor_text: Carved from a spire that fell in a storm.

flats_mabs_racing_goggles.name: Racing Goggles
flats_mabs_racing_goggles.flavor_text: The salt never quite comes off the lenses.

flats_mabs_nitro_boosted_boomstick.name: Nitro-Boosted Boomstick
flats_mabs_nitro_boosted_boomstick.flavor_text: Mabs says it's perfectly safe. Mabs is missing two fingers.

flats_mabs_crash_padded_leggings.name: Crash-Padded Leggings
flats_mabs_crash_padded_leggings.flavor_text: Designed after the third crash. Tested on the fourth.

tanaris_ahmiru_sunscorched_khopesh.name: Sunscorched Khopesh
tanaris_ahmiru_sunscorched_khopesh.flavor_text: The grip is too hot to hold at noon. Hold it anyway.

tanaris_ahmiru_dune_sealed_leggings.name: Dune-Sealed Leggings
tanaris_ahmiru_dune_sealed_leggings.flavor_text: Not one grain of sand gets in. Ahmiru guarantees it, loudly.

nstv_ezra_smugglers_hook_blade.name: Smuggler's Hook Blade
nstv_ezra_smugglers_hook_blade.flavor_text: Good for rigging, better for arguments.

nstv_ezra_powder_burned_gauntlets.name: Powder-Burned Gauntlets
nstv_ezra_powder_burned_gauntlets.flavor_text: Black to the elbow and proud of it.

nstv_ezra_jungle_run_musket.name: Jungle-Run Musket
nstv_ezra_jungle_run_musket.flavor_text: Wrapped in oilcloth for the wet season, which is every season.

cstv_jalu_zandali_bone_fetish.name: Zandali Bone Fetish
cstv_jalu_zandali_bone_fetish.flavor_text: It rattles when nobody is moving it.

cstv_jalu_jalus_ritual_mask.name: Jalu's Ritual Mask
cstv_jalu_jalus_ritual_mask.flavor_text: The eyes follow you. That's the point.

cstv_jalu_gurubashi_throwing_axe.name: Gurubashi Throwing Axe
cstv_jalu_gurubashi_throwing_axe.flavor_text: Balanced for a throw and a long walk to fetch it.

arathiw_wren_stromgarde_longsword.name: Stromgarde Longsword
arathiw_wren_stromgarde_longsword.flavor_text: Old Stromgarde steel. They don't make it like this any more because there's nobody left to.

arathiw_wren_highland_tabard_coat.name: Highland Tabard Coat
arathiw_wren_highland_tabard_coat.flavor_text: The crest has been unpicked. You can still see where it was.

arathiw_wren_wrens_crossbow.name: Wren's Crossbow
arathiw_wren_wrens_crossbow.flavor_text: He says it's never missed. He says a lot of things.

arathie_brakka_ogre_hide_belt.name: Ogre-Hide Belt
arathie_brakka_ogre_hide_belt.flavor_text: One belt. One very large ogre.

arathie_brakka_boulderfist_club.name: Boulderfist Club
arathie_brakka_boulderfist_club.flavor_text: Two rocks and a tree. Ogre craftsmanship.

arathie_brakka_coldwater_shield.name: Coldwater Shield
arathie_brakka_coldwater_shield.flavor_text: Still damp from the river she pulled it out of.

spnorth_moll_pyrewood_shroud.name: Pyrewood Shroud
spnorth_moll_pyrewood_shroud.flavor_text: It smells faintly of smoke and somebody's grandmother.

spnorth_moll_molls_shovel_blade.name: Moll's Shovel Blade
spnorth_moll_molls_shovel_blade.flavor_text: Sharpened on both edges, for reasons Moll keeps to herself.

fenris_ferrin_fenris_keep_signet.name: Fenris Keep Signet
fenris_ferrin_fenris_keep_signet.flavor_text: The keep's seal. The keep doesn't need it any more.

fenris_ferrin_ferrymans_oar_blade.name: Ferryman's Oar-Blade
fenris_ferrin_ferrymans_oar_blade.flavor_text: An oar, mostly. The rest is spite and an iron edge.

hillse_tamsin_hedgewitchs_bramble_staff.name: Hedgewitch's Bramble Staff
hillse_tamsin_hedgewitchs_bramble_staff.flavor_text: Still sprouting. She keeps meaning to trim it.

hillse_tamsin_thornwoven_gloves.name: Thornwoven Gloves
hillse_tamsin_thornwoven_gloves.flavor_text: Prickly on the outside, kind on the inside.

hillse_tamsin_witch_knot_amulet.name: Witch-Knot Amulet
hillse_tamsin_witch_knot_amulet.flavor_text: Tied in a knot nobody else in Hillsbrad remembers how to tie.

dk_grubbs_grubbs_shovel.name: Grubbs' Shovel
dk_grubbs_grubbs_shovel.flavor_text: Dug a lot of holes. Filled in most of them.

dk_grubbs_burial_gloves.name: Burial Gloves
dk_grubbs_burial_gloves.flavor_text: Never wash them. Grubbs certainly doesn't.

dk_grubbs_lantern_of_the_dug_up.name: Lantern of the Dug-Up
dk_grubbs_lantern_of_the_dug_up.flavor_text: A ledger of everyone he's dug up, and what they had on them.

vot_kazzik_runaways_wrench.name: Runaway's Wrench
vot_kazzik_runaways_wrench.flavor_text: He took it when he ran. He says it was owed.

vot_kazzik_spare_slingshot.name: Spare Slingshot
vot_kazzik_spare_slingshot.flavor_text: For the boar that chased him in here.

strand_kezz_deepwreck_harpoon.name: Deepwreck Harpoon
strand_kezz_deepwreck_harpoon.flavor_text: Barbed for something much bigger than you.

strand_kezz_abyssal_divers_helm.name: Abyssal Diver's Helm
strand_kezz_abyssal_divers_helm.flavor_text: Brass and glass. The glass is cracked from the inside.

cinder_varga_ashforged_greataxe.name: Ashforged Greataxe
cinder_varga_ashforged_greataxe.flavor_text: Forged in a fire nobody lit on purpose.

cinder_varga_cinder_proof_gauntlets.name: Cinder-Proof Gauntlets
cinder_varga_cinder_proof_gauntlets.flavor_text: She's put her hands in the fire to prove it. Twice.

glitter_nim_gem_studded_pick.name: Gem-Studded Pick
glitter_nim_gem_studded_pick.flavor_text: More gems in the handle than most mines have left.

glitter_nim_copperbolts_loupe.name: Copperbolt's Loupe
glitter_nim_copperbolts_loupe.flavor_text: Sees the flaw in every stone and most people.

glitter_nim_glittervein_band.name: Glittervein Band
glitter_nim_glittervein_band.flavor_text: Cut from a seam that isn't on any map.

saltspur_hewitt_hewitts_gaff_hook.name: Hewitt's Gaff Hook
saltspur_hewitt_hewitts_gaff_hook.flavor_text: Landed a shark with it once. The shark's still upset.

saltspur_hewitt_oilskin_souwester.name: Oilskin Sou'wester
saltspur_hewitt_oilskin_souwester.flavor_text: Keeps the rain off and the gossip in.

tempest_ilse_stormcallers_rod.name: Stormcaller's Rod
tempest_ilse_stormcallers_rod.flavor_text: The tip crackles before every storm. It's crackling now.

tempest_ilse_lightning_rod_pauldrons.name: Lightning-Rod Pauldrons
tempest_ilse_lightning_rod_pauldrons.flavor_text: Not recommended in a thunderstorm. Ilse wears them anyway.

tempest_ilse_tempest_glass_pendant.name: Tempest-Glass Pendant
tempest_ilse_tempest_glass_pendant.flavor_text: Glass made where lightning hit the sand.

underdark_haldur_crystal_edged_axe.name: Crystal-Edged Axe
underdark_haldur_crystal_edged_axe.flavor_text: The edge is a crystal that grew there. Haldur swears it.

underdark_haldur_deepdelves_hauberk.name: Deepdelve's Hauberk
underdark_haldur_deepdelves_hauberk.flavor_text: Three generations of Deepdelves. One very long tunnel.

underdark_haldur_glowcap_lantern.name: Glowcap Lantern
underdark_haldur_glowcap_lantern.flavor_text: Lit by mushrooms. Don't eat the lamp.

uc_squeak_gnawed_signet.name: Gnawed Signet
uc_squeak_gnawed_signet.flavor_text: Somebody's seal ring. Somebody's teeth marks.

uc_squeak_sewerslick_slippers.name: Sewer-Slick Slippers
uc_squeak_sewerslick_slippers.flavor_text: Slightly damp. Slightly chewed. Very comfortable.

uc_squeak_a_very_good_stick.name: A Very Good Stick
uc_squeak_a_very_good_stick.flavor_text: Squeak's favourite. It's giving it up for you, and that should mean something.

sands_cinder_ashheart_mantle.name: Ashheart Mantle
sands_cinder_ashheart_mantle.flavor_text: Warm on the coldest night. Uncomfortably warm on every other.
